Full job description

About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.


Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Summary:

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated senior-level Cloud Engineer, responsible for designing, maintaining, and securing the hosting platform for two distinct global SaaS products. This role develops tools and services to streamline operations and the platform development experience, and brings subject matter expertise in cloud-native architecture and progressive delivery.

What You'll Do:

Technical Collaboration

Define and promote cloud-native architectural patterns, and own adherence to them across the platform.
Lead architecture decisions and design reviews, and act as the escalation point for complex problems.
Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team.

Platform Operations, Reliability & Availability

Design, implement, and maintain a secure and scalable infrastructure platform hosting a myriad of services for a global SaaS organization.
Own the service level objectives (SLOs) that underpin our internal and external SLAs, and ensure they are consistently met, with a focus on high availability, resilience, and scalability across the estate.
Drive observability and monitoring improvements across infrastructure, platforms, and services to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Drive capacity planning and cloud cost optimization initiatives.

Compliance & Security

Apply and uphold relevant security and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, and NIST SP 800-53) in platform design and operations.

Automation, IaC

Own the full solution design lifecycle — analysis, architecture, development, deployment, and ongoing operation.
Drive the evolution of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and progressive delivery to improve delivery speed, consistency, and reliability.
Reduce operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and standardization.

What You'll Need:

Technical Foundation

7+ years in infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production.
Deep understanding of software development methodologies and systems design.
Experience in software development and large-scale SaaS operations.
Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues across every layer of the stack, and drive incident resolution at the platform level.

Platform & Tooling

Production experience with Kubernetes and other cloud-native technologies.
Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking, covering CNI and network policy (e.g., Azure CNI, Cilium).
Experience operating edge services — CDN, WAF, and DDoS protection (e.g., Cloudflare, Imperva, Azure Front Door).
Deep experience using, operating, and developing on top of Azure cloud services.
Strong command of infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates) and reusable IaC module design.
Strong command of CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling.
Advanced proficiency with observability and monitoring solutions (e.g., Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Datadog).
Fluency in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go) and strong shell scripting skills (e.g., Bash, PowerShell).

Compliance & Security

Strong understanding of cloud security and compliance frameworks, with proven ability to align cloud environments to standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and NIST SP 800-53.

Professional & Interpersonal

Proven problem-solving skills and experience working collaboratively in a team environment.
Highly responsible, self-motivated, and able to thrive in an energetic, fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Effective communication skills to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and ability to produce clear documentation.
Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to adapt to a constantly changing technical environment.

Education

A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science or software engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

We'd Love to See:

Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
Hands-on experience operating a service within a FedRAMP authorization boundary.
Experience building self-service tooling for product engineering teams.

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.




Why work at Delinea?

We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
